admission.justification: The approved appendix explicitly weighs automatic link carry and rejects its cross-owner rewrite consequence. This admission concerns the no-carry choice only, not an unimplemented reader stale-body display.

alternatives.option: Keep authored record-link anchors without automatically carrying and rewriting other owners records on each run.
alternatives.reason: The carry owner updates realizes/proves entries, not arbitrary record links: automatic carry would rewrite other owners records on each run. Current record readers serialize stored link anchors. This inspected path does not compare their recorded content digest or emit stale-body currentness; it must not be described as delivered compensation for the no-carry choice.
